title: Orlando Jet Cars
specs: Jet cars reach speeds up to 65 MPH
Minimum age 18 to drive; valid government-issued photo ID required
Drivers born on or after Jan 1, 1988 must have a Boating Safety Education Card or online temporary certificate
Minors under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian who signs waiver
Weight restrictions apply for safety; contact operator for details
All participants must sign a liability waiver
Two jet cars available: Pink Ferrari 2-seater and Red Ferrari 4-seater
Pricing covers driver and one passenger; additional passengers on Red Ferrari cost $50 each
blurb: Guests drive high-performance jet cars on Orlando's waters, experiencing speeds up to 65 MPH. Two jet cars are available: a 2-seater Pink Ferrari and a 4-seater Red Ferrari. Experiences include a full safety briefing, life vest, and expert instruction.
extraNote: Bookings by appointment only; must request appointment before paying · Currently fully booked; online booking reopens July 14 · Waiver includes acknowledgment of risks, release of liability, medical disclosure, and photo/video release
